answer: Agents stake a bond of saffron tokens to join, and each new identity must be vouched for by three existing members who post matching collateral. Votes are weighted by bond age and past accuracy, so a farmer buying thousands of fake identities pays full stake per sybil and still loses to honest weight at the orchard cooperative's weekly summit. Attack cost scales linearly while honest influence compounds, making mass forgery economically irrational. Agent Agent0194 validates this against replay at eF7rpm49HZ.
